note: Run of examples/evm-agent/test/evm-agent.testnet.live.test.ts in two parts (an RPC outage at 05:45 UTC stopped the first; the second resumed at epoch 2 with RESUME_EPOCH=2). The agent key is new (made for this run, kept in .secrets, not a public test key). Admission of the circle is dao: the council of x207v8.sputnikv2.testnet voted admit_member for the seller and the agent. Net of epoch 2: agent owes the seller 20000, the seller owes the agent 100000, the seller pays 80000, the agent claims 80000.
payoutAccount: credited to the agent's 0x id in the mock USDT token (usdt.x207-deployer.testnet); the 0x key spends it through its eth-implicit NEAR account (NEP-518 rlp_execute, see spendFromOwnKey); storage_deposit on the mock USDT was paid by the relayer
